title: A user disabled or demoted in the admin UI / SCIM is refused at login and on every request, and an admin role edit no longer re-enables them

criteria.given: an account whose USERS.ENABLED flag is off (SCIM deactivate)
criteria.then: form login, HTTP Basic and an existing session are all refused: the web layer consults the account status

criteria.given: an account whose USER_ROLES no longer include an admin role
criteria.then: the request is served without that admin authority

criteria.given: an admin edits a deactivated user's roles or email
criteria.then: the account stays disabled (the update statement no longer hard-codes enabled = TRUE)
